details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:_inject_token_into_url lines 3040-3052, _resolve_origin_url lines 3077-3084 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: GH_TOKEN/GH_PAT is embedded in memory clone URLs instead of being supplied through the existing per-process `http.extraHeader` authentication contract.
  WHY: The token becomes visible in process argv, `/proc/<pid>/cmdline`, Git remotes, `.git/config`, diagnostics, and error output, reversing the documented credential-isolation contract.

- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:_memory_force_tick_remote_url line 585 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: GH_PAT/GH_TOKEN is embedded in the force-tick remote URL.
  WHY: The credential is passed to `git ls-remote`, `git clone`, and `git push` through argv and can be persisted in `.git/config` or emitted in Git errors.

- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:Lines 151-152, 180, 770, 886, 922 — bare git calls | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `_memory_git` was removed and memory operations now use bare Git commands.
  WHY: With `persist-credentials: false`, branch creation and force-tick reads/writes cannot authenticate and fail open, silently dropping memory updates.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:normalize_path lines 241-245, emit_context loop line 568; deletion of sensitivity helpers near lines 154-168 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Sensitive-path filtering and path normalization are removed, and `emit_context` iterates raw caller paths.
  WHY: Targets such as `.git/config`, `.env.production`, `.ssh/id_rsa`, and `.aws/credentials` can be read and inlined into model prompts; tests importing `MAX_TARGET_PATHS` and `is_sensitive_target_path` also fail collection.

- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:Line 664; removal of broker setup at line 51 and lines 210-217 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The diagnose phase changed from brokered read-only execution to direct Codex execution with `--sandbox danger-full-access` and the ambient `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`.
  WHY: Issue-derived diagnostics can mutate the workspace and access the live provider credential, bypassing the documented broker isolation boundary.

- scripts/codex_helpers.sh:Lines 135-140 (end of file), the deleted model_provider_broker_* family | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The `model_provider_broker_*` helper family was deleted while numerous scripts and workflows still invoke it.
  WHY: Brokered phases abort with command-not-found under `set -euo pipefail` before model startup, matching the seven empty-editor CI runs.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:Lines 493-494 (post-deletion), formerly `git_with_github_auth`; lines 947-952, the removed `review_blocked_*` family | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `git_with_github_auth` and the review-blocked approval/successor helper family were deleted while callers remain.
  WHY: Review-blocked pushes, approval publication and verification, successor-issue resolution, and consumed-marker recording fail with command-not-found or unauthenticated Git operations.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:REST and GraphQL comment projections at lines 732-739, 766-780, 793-799, 833-839, 913-924, 947-952 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Comment projections drop `id`, `author_id`, `author_type`, and `author_association`.
  WHY: Review-blocked approval authentication, producer-marker discovery, trusted-user filtering, and comment-thread resolution cannot identify valid comments, leaving terminal flows pending.

- scripts/write_codex_config.sh:Lines 99-114 (argument parser), line 261 (hardcoded base_url) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `--provider-base-url` was removed while callers still pass it, and `base_url` is hardcoded to `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1`.
  WHY: Config generation exits with an unknown-argument error before model startup; accepting and ignoring the option would bypass the broker's loopback credential proxy.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:emit_context lines 562-564 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `max_bytes <= 0` now emits a header and marker instead of returning the established empty string.
  WHY: Callers using zero as the disable switch receive non-empty targeted context and the existing zero-byte contract test fails.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:emit_context lines 576-578; summary/omission accounting lines 685-710 | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Missing-file markers do not increment `used_bytes`, and the `MAX_TARGET_PATHS` cap was removed.
  WHY: An unbounded list of nonexistent paths can produce output beyond `max_bytes` and exceed the downstream prompt budget.

- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh:_signal_child_group lines 404-407; _kill_child_group_if_running lines 439-448; idle-kill escalation lines 560-583; final survivor check lines 585-587 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Privileged signalling short-circuits once the tracked sudo wrapper exits, so surviving isolated process-group members are only verified or logged and are not signalled.
  WHY: After SIGTERM kills sudo while a nobody-owned editor survives, the delayed SIGKILL and later kill paths no-op; severity is BLOCKER in five reviews and MAJOR in moonshotai_kimi-k3.

- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:terminate_editor_attempt_process_group lines 295-301, 320-330; watchdog calls at lines 2178 and 2200 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Missing metadata, unavailable signalling helpers, or signalling failures cause fallback termination of only the runner-owned guard PID, while callers discard the failure with `|| true`.
  WHY: The nobody-owned editor can survive watchdog termination and remain active during workspace cleanup; severity is BLOCKER in five reviews and NIT in moonshotai_kimi-k3.

- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh:Lines 484-490 (`signal_failure` short-circuit), 486-490 (`wrapper_returncode = 126`) | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: A failed privileged signal breaks the select loop and skips reaping the child before returning 126.
  WHY: A failed kill becomes terminal rather than a retry path, and the parent receives a failure code even if the group is subsequently gone.

- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh:Lines 351-359 and 361-374 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: `pgrep` errors are treated as evidence that isolated group members still exist.
  WHY: Transient diagnostic failures produce misleading survivor messages and can force a spurious signal failure and return code 126.

- scripts/editor_isolation_preflight.sh:Lines 99-141, 165-179 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Process-group metadata and the live child PGID are validated once and used later without revalidation.
  WHY: A TOCTOU race could signal a stale PGID after the original child exits and another process inherits the group.

- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:2154-2165, 2318-2333 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The post-`cmd_rc` verification bypasses process-group verification when the metadata file is empty.
  WHY: A surviving nobody-owned child can escape verification if the guard exits before writing metadata.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:Line 62-68 | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The cleanup path restores only the worktree and no longer unstages cached deletion or removes cached artifacts.
  WHY: A staged deletion or staged artifact can still be committed, defeating the preservation guard; severity is MAJOR in two reviews and NIT in x-ai_grok-4_6.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Give the stall guard a privileged kill path when the editor is isolated ... signal the group via `sudo -n kill -<SIG> -- -<pgid>` ... The stall guard's idle kill (codex_stall_killed) cannot take effect on the isolated editor."
  expected_change_site: scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh, _signal_child_group and the idle-kill escalation path
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  EVIDENCE: `_signal_child_group` returns when `child.poll() is not None` at lines 404-407; idle SIGKILL is gated at lines 560-567; `_kill_child_group_if_running` only verifies survivors at lines 441-444 and does not retry privileged signalling.

- requirement: "Make the `review_apply_fixes.sh` watchdog kill the editor's process group the same privileged way (and only then the guard), so a wall-time or idle kill actually stops `opencode` before `cleanup_editor_isolation` chowns the workspace back."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh, `terminate_editor_attempt_process_group`, watchdog sites at lines 2178 and 2200
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  EVIDENCE: Both watchdog call sites use `terminate_editor_attempt_process_group ... || true`; fallback handling kills only the guard when metadata or signalling helpers are unavailable.

- requirement: "After every kill path, verify no `nobody`-owned process from the editor's group is still alive (`pgrep -u nobody -g <pgid>`) and log it if so."
  expected_change_site: scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh, `_kill_child_group_if_running`; scripts/editor_isolation_preflight.sh; scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: `_kill_child_group_if_running` verifies survivors but does not signal them after the wrapper exits; the other kill paths can leave the isolated group alive on failure or fallback.

- requirement: "This must not weaken the isolation contract: the privileged kill is the only new `sudo` use, limited to signalling the editor's own process group."
  expected_change_site: scripts/codex_helpers.sh, scripts
